model.execution_path: Claude Code in VS Code on the owner's laptop, Workflow tool subagents
model.execution_notes: Subagents inherit the session model. Their system prompt and the repository instructions the harness injects (the engine checkout's CLAUDE.md, which imports AGENTS.md, at 5f0b5150 on main, the session's project directory) are outside this pilot's control; prompt hashes cover only the user-turn prompt. The planning steps ran in a subagent of the same session; the main session launches the workflows. The workflow scripts run from the run directory inside the session scratchpad worktree (branch claude/pilot-run3), as run 2's did, so no copy of the scripts is needed.
